subject: Audit & Access Log retention/export options for AcmeHealth
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit & access log retention/export options

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

We're compiling documentation for a regulatory review and need a clear statement of Redwood's capabilities around audit and access logs for our tenant. Specifically:

- Retention windows you support out-of-the-box and what is configurable per-tenant.
- Export formats you can deliver (raw syslog, JSONL, compressed bundles) and recommended timelines for large datasets.
- Deletion guarantees and proof-of-deletion artifacts we can obtain.

Can you send a short Q&A and any example artifacts? Our compliance lead (compliance@acmehealth.com) is copied.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of IT Compliance
AcmeHealth

--
This is an initial inquiry — if easier we can hop on a short call next week.

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit & access log retention/export options

Thanks Liam — appreciate the clear list. Quick answers below; Marissa and Karthik, adding you for any details or artifacts.

1) Retention windows
- Hosted (default): 90 days indexed; raw trace slices retained 180 days.
- Dedicated: configurable from 30 days up to 7 years depending on contract (we'll need to set retention in the Dedicated config).
- Private/on-prem: retention is customer-managed (we provide the export and deletion hooks).

2) Export formats and delivery
- Supported: JSONL (per-event), gzipped newline-delimited JSON (for bulk), and syslog-compatible NDJSON.
- Delivery: S3 signed URL, SCP over your VPN, or encrypted transfer to your storage endpoint. Very large historical exports are chunked (default 10GB gzipped slices) and we provide a manifest with checksums. Typical throughput: 200GB/day from a single export job; we can parallelize for faster delivery.

3) Deletion guarantees and proof
- For hosted: we provide audit events that show deletion requests + tombstone markers, and a signed manifest showing which object keys were removed.
- For Dedicated/Private: we run customer-triggered erasure and provide an attestation report (PDF) with timestamps and SHA256 digest of the removed export manifest.

I'll attach a draft playbook and a sample manifest. Marissa — can you attach the manifest example and the playbook PDF? Also Karthik, can you confirm the chunking/default slice size and whether we support longer retention for mid-market SOC customers without a contract amendment?

Best,
Jonas
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit & access log retention/export options

Hi Liam — attaching the artifacts Jonas mentioned. Quick clarifications inline below.

- Retention: For hosted tenants we can provide a 180-day "archive" hold (raw slices) as a temporary add-on for up to 12 months on request; anything beyond 12 months requires a Dedicated reservation or Private deployment.

- Export formats: we also support a parquet export option for analytics customers (columnar, compressed) if you plan to ingest into a lake. Parquet exports are chunked into ~5–8GB parts to keep downstream ingestion fast.

- Deletion/playback: Proof-of-deletion artifacts include: signed deletion manifest (CSV), removal audit events (JSONL), and an optional notarized attestation (third-party PDF) if required by auditors.

Attachments in this thread:
- audit_manifest_v1.csv (sample manifest listing object keys + sha256)
- export_playbook_draft.pdf (playbook with runbook steps, timelines, and contact points)

Notes on timelines: a 30-day historical export (roughly 600GB) would typically complete within 48–72 hours with our parallel export job; we schedule larger jobs during off-peak windows and provide incremental access URLs as chunks finish.

Olga, can you add the exact default chunk size and the S3 presign TTL in the thread?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments:
- audit_manifest_v1.csv (15KB)
- export_playbook_draft.pdf (220KB)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@acmehealth.com>, Sandra Miller <sandra.miller@finvero.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit & access log retention/export options

Thanks team — that is very helpful. A couple quick follow-ups:

1) For the attestation, we need timezone-consistent ISO timestamps in the deletion manifest. Can you confirm the timestamp format (we prefer UTC with millis).
2) Will the signed deletion manifest be cryptographically verifiable (signature + public key) so our auditors can validate it programmatically?
3) For the 180-day hosted archive add-on: what's the cost model and do you need an order form or PO?

If you can send a one-page summary we can circulate internally. Also, happy to take a 30-min call to finalize technical acceptance criteria with our security team.

Appreciate the quick turnaround —
Liam
Head of IT Compliance, AcmeHealth
